business_summary: Zhuzhou Hongda Electronics Corp.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and servicing of electronic components and circuit modules in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through HTC Branch and Xiangyi Branch segments. The company offers power modules and IF converters; microstrip circulator isolators comprising microstrip isolators and circulators, conventional microstrip circulator isolators, shielded microstrip circulator assemblies, tri-junction microstrip circulator assemblies, ultra-wideband microstrip circulators/isolators, and surface-mount microstrip circulators/isolators; tantalum capacitors consisting of non-solid and solid electrolyte products; polymer tantalum capacitors, such as chip-type polymer solid electrolyte tantalum capacitors with reliability specifications; and multilayer ceramic capacitors, including single-core and multi-core products. It also provides high-temperature tantalum capacitors, such as tantalum capacitors with metallic silver casings, resin-encapsulated solid tantalum capacitors, and all-tantalum capacitors; tantalum capacitors for civilian use, including non-solid and solid electrolyte tantalum capacitors; organic film capacitors; power, RF, plug-in, and custom inductors, as well as stacked devices and multi-winding products; resistors; and modules and DC/DC converters. The company's products are used in aircraft, vehicles, ships, radars, electronics, smartphones, industrial control equipment, medical equipment, charging piles, laptops, instruments and meters, automotive electronics, and other fields. It exports its products to Russia, India, and Europe. Zhuzhou Hongda Electronics Corp.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Zhuzhou, China.
